arxiv-2201-02205.title: Solving Combinatorial Problems at Particle Colliders Using Machine Learning
arxiv-2201-02205.creator: Anthony Badea, William James Fawcett, John Huth, Teng Jian Khoo, Riccardo Poggi, Lawrence Lee
arxiv-2201-02205.description: Abstract High-multiplicity signatures at particle colliders can arise in Standard Model processes and beyond. With such signatures, difficulties often arise from the large dimensionality of the kinematic space. For final states containing a single type of particle signature, this results in a combinatorial problem that hides underlying kinematic information.

arxiv-2201-09323.title: Dual-Frequency Quantum Phase Estimation Mitigates the Spectral Leakage of Quantum Algorithms Thanks: The authors are with School of Electronics and Computer Science, University of Southampton, SO17 1BJ, Southampton (UK). Thanks: L. Hanzo would like to acknowledge the financial support of the Enginee
arxiv-2201-09323.creator: Yifeng Xiong, Soon Xin Ng, Gui-Lu Long
arxiv-2201-09323.description: Abstract Quantum phase estimation is an important component in diverse quantum algorithms. However, it suffers from spectral leakage, when the reciprocal of the record length is not an integer multiple of the unknown phase, which incurs an accuracy degradation. For the existing single-sample estimation scheme, window-based methods have been proposed for spectral leakage mitigation.

arxiv-2203-11441.title: Multi-Modal Learning for AU Detection Based on Multi-Head Fused Transformers
arxiv-2203-11441.creator: Xiang Zhang and Lijun Yin Department of Computer Science, State University of New York at Binghamton, NY, USA
arxiv-2203-11441.description: Abstract Multi-modal learning has been intensified in recent years, especially for applications in facial analysis and action unit detection whilst there still exist two main challenges in terms of 1) relevant feature learning for representation and 2) efficient fusion for multi-modalities.

arxiv-2205-13878.title: On local uniqueness of normalized Nash equilibria
arxiv-2205-13878.creator: Vladimir Shikhman
arxiv-2205-13878.description: Abstract . For generalized Nash equilibrium problems (GNEP) with shared constraints we focus on the notion of normalized Nash equilibrium in the nonconvex setting. The property of nondegeneracy for normalized Nash equilibria is introduced. Nondegeneracy refers to GNEP-tailored versions of linear independence constraint qualification, strict complementarity and second-order regularity.

arxiv-2305-03782.title: Optically driven spin precession in polariton condensates
arxiv-2305-03782.creator: Ivan Gnusov, Stepan Baryshev, Helgi Sigurðsson, Kirill Sitnik, Julian Töpfer, Sergey Alyatkin, Pavlos G. Lagoudakis
arxiv-2305-03782.description: Abstract External driving of spinor degrees of freedom by magnetic or optical fields in quantum systems underpin many applications ranging from nuclear magnetic resonance to coherent state control in quantum computing. Although spinor polariton condensates are offering a flexible platform for spinoptronic applications, strong inter-particle interactions limit their spin coherence.

arxiv-2404-18638.title: Reinforcement Learning Problem Solving with Large Language Models
arxiv-2404-18638.creator: Sina Gholamian, Domingo Huh
arxiv-2404-18638.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) encapsulate an extensive amount of world knowledge, and this has enabled their application in various domains to improve the performance of a variety of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. This has also facilitated a more accessible paradigm of conversation-based interactions between humans and AI systems to solve intended problems.

arxiv-2409-04735.title: Counting points on generic character varieties
arxiv-2409-04735.creator: Stefano Giannini 1, Masoud Kamgarpour 2, GyeongHyeon Nam 3, Bailey Whitbread 4
arxiv-2409-04735.description: Abstract . We count points on character varieties associated with punctured surfaces and regular semisimple generic conjugacy classes in reductive groups. We find that the number of points are palindromic polynomials. This suggests a P = W P=W conjecture for these varieties.

arxiv-2410-05521.title: Stein spaces and Stein algebras
arxiv-2410-05521.creator: Olivier Benoist
arxiv-2410-05521.description: Abstract . We prove that the category of Stein spaces and holomorphic maps is anti-equivalent to the category of Stein algebras and ℂ \mathbb{C} -algebra morphisms. This removes a finite dimensionality hypothesis from a theorem of Forster. Introduction Complex spaces are a generalization of complex manifolds allowing singularities, and as such are the basic objects of study in complex-analytic geometry.

arxiv-2509-13158.title: Hybrid Active-Passive Galactic Cosmic Ray Simulator: experimental implementation and microdosimetric characterization Journal: Life Sciences in Space Research
arxiv-2509-13158.creator: E. Pierobon, L. Lunati, T. Wagner, M. Durante, C. Schuy
arxiv-2509-13158.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by E. Pierobon, L. Lunati, T. Wagner, M. Durante, C. Schuy. Space radiation is one of the major obstacles to space exploration. If not mitigated, radiation can interact both with biological and electronic systems, inducing damage and posing significant risk to space missions. Countermeasures can only be studied effectively with ground-based accelerators that act as a proxy for space radiation, typically with a harsher radiation field that worsen the effects of space radiation.

arxiv-2512-04015.title: Learning Group Actions In Disentangled Latent Image Representations
arxiv-2512-04015.creator: Farhana Hossain Swarnali, Miaomiao Zhang, Tonmoy Hossain, Genuity Systems Limited, Computer Science, Electrical, Computer Engineering, School of Engineering, Applied Science, University of Virginia, farhanaswarnali@gmail.com, {mz8rr,tonmoy}@virginia.edu
arxiv-2512-04015.description: Abstract Modeling group actions on latent representations enables controllable transformations of high-dimensional image data. Prior works applying group-theoretic priors or modeling transformations typically operate in the high-dimensional data space, where group actions apply uniformly across the entire input, making it difficult to disentangle the subspace that varies under transformations.

arxiv-2602-15758.title: ChartEditBench: Evaluating Grounded Multi-Turn Chart Editing in Multimodal Language Models
arxiv-2602-15758.creator: Manav Nitin Kapadnis Lawanya Baghel Atharva Naik Carolyn Rosé
arxiv-2602-15758.description: Abstract While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strongly on single-turn chart generation, their ability to support real-world exploratory data analysis remains underexplored. In practice, users iteratively refine visualizations through multi-turn interactions that require maintaining common ground, tracking prior edits, and adapting to evolving preferences.

pmc-10519991.title: Zinc nanoparticles ameliorated obesity-induced cardiovascular disease: role of metabolic syndrome and iron overload
pmc-10519991.creator: Samir A E Bashandy, Ahmed M A El-Seidy, Fatma A A Ibrahim, Sahar S Abdelrahman, Sherif A Abdelmottaleb Moussa, Marawan A ElBaset
pmc-10519991.description: Obesity is a complicated disease characterized by abundant fat accumulation. It is associated with cardiovascular disease. The current study aimed to appreciate the role of synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnONPs) (18.72 nm in size) in curbing cardiovascular disease in an obesity model of a high fat/sucrose diet in male rats.

pmc-10730927.creator: Leonid L. Moroz

pmc-11339455.title: Endometriotic lesions exhibit distinct metabolic signature compared to paired eutopic endometrium at the single-cell level
pmc-11339455.creator: Meruert Sarsenova, Ankita Lawarde, Amruta D S Pathare, Merli Saare, Vijayachitra Modhukur, Pille Soplepmann, Anton Terasmaa, Tuuli Käämbre, Kristina Gemzell-Danielsson, Parameswaran Grace Luther Lalitkumar, Andres Salumets, Maire Peters
pmc-11339455.description: Current therapeutics of endometriosis focus on hormonal disruption of endometriotic lesions (ectopic endometrium, EcE). Recent findings show higher glycolysis utilization in EcE, suggesting non-hormonal strategy for disease treatment that addresses cellular metabolism. Identifying metabolically altered cell types in EcE is important for targeted metabolic drug therapy without affecting eutopic endometrium (EuE).

pmc-11693193.title: CHALLENGES AND INSIGHTS: EVALUATING LIFE STORY WORK’S ROLE IN DEMENTIA CARE POST-PANDEMIC
pmc-11693193.creator: Lacey DiFranco, Silvia Orsulic-Jeras, Sara Powers, Lisbeth Sanders
pmc-11693193.description: Decades of research have demonstrated that life story work can be an invaluable tool for residential care staff and individuals living with dementia. This study examines outcomes from 53 residential care staff (Mage=46.2 years, 92.5% female) implementing LifeBio Memory™ – an application that utilizes voice recorded interviews and artificial intelligence to automate production of resident story books and resources.

pmc-12397144.title: Mesenteric approach for borderline resectable pancreatic head cancer: a 13-year retrospective cohort study
pmc-12397144.creator: Fang-Fei Wang, Qiang He, Shao-Cheng Lyu
pmc-12397144.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the value of mesenteric approach for borderline resectable pancreatic head cancer (BRPHC).MethodsAccording to the inclusion and exclusion criteria, the data of 203 patients with borderline resectable pancreatic head cancer (BRPHC) who underwent radical pancreatoduodenectomy in our center from January 2011 to December 2023 were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-12470689.title: Multimodal Imaging from Fetal to Adult Life: A Comprehensive Approach to Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome (HLHS)
pmc-12470689.creator: Sara Moscatelli, Jolanda Sabatino, Isabella Leo, Nunzia Borrelli, Martina Avesani, Giovanni Di Salvo, Claudia Montanaro, Valeria Pergola, Raffaella Motta, Jessica Ielapi, Assunta Di Costanzo, Rosalba De Sarro, Giulia Guglielmi, Irene Cattapan, Gabriella Gaudieri, Leonie Luedke, Marco Alfonso Perrone
pmc-12470689.description: Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome (HLHS) accounts for 2–3% of congenital heart diseases (CHDs). HLHS is characterized by reduced systemic blood flow due to hypoplastic left ventricle (LV) and underdeveloped left-sided cardiac structures. Without a series of staged interventional treatments, HLHS is often fatal, typically within the first hours or days of life.

pmc-13307636.title: Administration Timing of Respiratory Syncytial Virus Preventatives Among Commercially Insured Populations in the United States: 2024–2025 RSV Season
pmc-13307636.creator: Amy W. Law, Danielle C. Mayer, Marjan Zakeri, Nehir Yapar, Alexandra Passarelli, Onur Baser, Pia D. M. MacDonald
pmc-13307636.description: Background/Objectives: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of infant hospitalizations in the United States. Prevention strategies are recommended to mitigate severe RSV outcomes. In addition to identifying potential coverage gaps, preventative administration timing is important for estimating product effectiveness.

pmc-13465901.title: Comment on: Can depression, anxiety, and stress predict smoking?
pmc-13465901.creator: Parthkumar Dhameliya
pmc-13465901.description: the authors have contributed a vital perspective to our understanding of regional public health dynamics. A primary takeaway from their analysis is the positive correlation between anxiety and smoking behaviors. This reinforces a global body of literature suggesting that nicotine is frequently utilized as a form of self-medication to manage anxious symptoms.
